title: An Occasional Bloom
description: An Australian wattlebird (Anthochaera) balances on a native Australian grass tree (Xanthorrhoea). These slow-growing perennials produce towering flower spikes that can reach two to four meters tall and drip with nectar, attracting birds, butterflies, and native bees.
translated_description: 一只澳大利亚食蜜鸟（Anthochaera）平衡地站在澳大利亚本土的草树（Xanthorrhoea）上。这些生长缓慢的多年生植物会长出高耸的花穗，花穗可达两到四米高，滴落着花蜜，吸引着鸟类、蝴蝶和本土蜜蜂。
